description: The six classic Eagan Matrix macros, i to vi, as knobs with a control voltage input for each; it works through a CHEM Core

params.text: Sets that macro on the instrument, 0-10V, and the preset is what gives the macro its meaning
Sets how far the voltage at the selected input moves its macro, from -100% to 100%, a negative amount inverting the voltage; the knob does nothing until a cable is patched

inputs.text: Moves the macro of the same number away from its knob setting, bipolar, scaled by the modulation amount knob and clamped to the macro's 0-10V span

notes: nothing reaches the instrument until the module is linked to a CHEM Core; putting it beside a linked CHEM module links it, or click the link button at the bottom of the panel to pick a Core
one input at a time is under the modulation amount knob; patching a cable moves the knob to that jack and lights the lamp beside it, and clicking a jack or its label moves the knob to that one
when a pedal is assigned to one of these macros, a small annotation such as p2 appears beside that knob
menu: Zero modulation — sets the modulation amount on every input of this module to zero
Center knobs — sets all six macro knobs to the middle of their range

±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
